correctness.rationale: For all integers m,n>=1 and gamma,B>0, the proof first excludes nonzero boundary equilibria, then uses a symmetric edge-square identity to force beta_i=c(1-x_i). Strict monotonicity of x/(1-x)^2 forces within-part equality, after which positive odds give a unique scalar eta exactly when B>gamma(m+n)/sqrt(mn). Explicit substitution proves stationarity and mass conservation; the fixed-mass disease-free Jacobian establishes its claimed hyperbolic stability/instability away from the threshold. Independent direct vertexwise checks passed 128 exact rational supercritical, 972 floating supercritical, and 363 disease-free cases. Tests cannot replace the infinite symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Exact closed-form endemic prevalence and endogenous nodal infection-rate allocation for all unequal bicliques (including stars) fills a naturally motivated nonregular family left with only general approximations in the source. The forced symmetry and exact levels make the already structurally implied opposite rankings quantitatively explicit, with epidemiological/traffic interpretation: the side with higher endemic risk has the lower flow-driven infection load. The exact formula supplies a parameter-wide benchmark, not a single trivial substitution or finite enumeration.
